Terms & Conditions

The terms that apply to quotes, bookings and work carried out by Campbelltown Landscapers.

props.label: 1. About these terms
props.html:
Last updated: July 2026

1. About these terms

These Terms & Conditions govern quotes, bookings and landscaping work provided by Campbelltown Landscapers ("we", "us", "our"), a licensed contractor (licence 353-827-C) operating across the Campbelltown and Macarthur region of New South Wales. By requesting a quote or engaging us for work, you ("the client") agree to these terms.

2. Quotes and pricing

Coming out to inspect your job and provide a quote is free, with no call-out fee. Quotes are provided on a fixed-price basis for the scope of work described. A quote is valid for 30 days unless stated otherwise, and is based on the site conditions and information available at the time of inspection.

Our "we beat any quote" offer is subject to conditions and requires a valid, written, comparable quote for the same scope of work.

3. Acceptance and bookings

Work is scheduled once you accept a quote. We will agree a start window with you. Timeframes given are estimates in good faith and may be affected by weather, access, materials availability, or matters outside our control.

4. Variations

If the scope changes, or conditions are found that could not reasonably be seen at the time of quoting (for example unexpected ground conditions, buried services or rock), we will discuss any change in price with you before carrying out the additional work.

5. Site access and client responsibilities

You agree to provide safe, clear access to the work area and to identify any known underground services, boundaries or hazards. Where required, you are responsible for obtaining any body-corporate, neighbour or council approvals, unless we have agreed in writing to arrange these on your behalf.

6. Council approvals

Some works — such as larger retaining walls, structures near boundaries, or tree removal — may require development approval or a permit. We will flag anything that appears to need approval, and can prepare council-ready plans, but final responsibility for approvals rests with the property owner unless otherwise agreed.

7. Payment

Payment terms will be set out in your quote or invoice. Unless agreed otherwise, invoices are payable by the due date shown. For larger projects a deposit or progress payments may apply.

8. Workmanship and plants

We take care to build for local conditions, including reactive clay soils and our heat and frost swings. Living materials such as turf and plants depend on watering, weather and aftercare once we leave site, so their establishment cannot be guaranteed. We will provide reasonable aftercare guidance on request.

9. Liability

Nothing in these terms excludes rights you have under the Australian Consumer Law. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to re-performing the affected work or the cost of doing so. We are not liable for indirect or consequential loss.

10. Cancellations

If you need to cancel or reschedule, please give us as much notice as possible. Where we have already incurred costs (for example ordered materials), those costs may be payable.

11. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia.

12. Contact

Questions about these terms? Call us on 0457 897 659 or reach us through our contact page.
